verdicts.quote: A thing is stronger than anything here
verdicts.reason: This is inaccurate: “a thing” in negative contexts is an emphatic equivalent of “anything,” rather than a stronger word.
Creature is not a close synonym in the sympathetic address use of thing and can sound impersonal or negative for a person.
This sense also occurs in plural form when it means a current fashion, as in “Short jackets are the thing this year.”
The expression is especially common in spoken informal discourse and should carry an appropriate register label.
